mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in GDPC1, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 YoY growth accelerates by > 2pp but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year change in industrial production (INDPRO) exceeds 4%, it signals a supply-side overheating that will lead to inflationary pressures and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO YoY change exceeds 4% but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive > 60% of the time, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5pp over 3 months signals a weakening labor market and slowing economy, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE rises > 0.5pp over 3 months but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive > 60% of the time, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4% and rising, it signals a tightening monetary policy that will slow economic growth and produce negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS > 4% and rising but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive > 60% of the time, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) decline by more than 10% year-over-year and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is rising, it signals a weakening consumer sector that will drag down S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST YoY change < -10% and UNRATE rising but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive > 60% of the time, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the industrial production index (INDPRO) is above its 12-month moving average and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 2%, it signals a favorable supply-side environment that will support positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO > 12mo MA and FEDFUNDS < 2% but SPX 20-day forward returns are negative > 40% of the time, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) is rising faster than the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS), it signals a loss of real purchasing power that will erode consumer spending and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL YoY change > FEDFUNDS but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive > 60% of the time, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 4% and falling, and payroll employment (PAYEMS) is rising faster than its 12-month moving average, it signals a tight labor market that will support wage growth and consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE < 4% and falling, PAYEMS > 12mo MA but SPX 20-day forward returns are negative > 40% of the time, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
